entries.reason: R1 — Impl review schema/prompt require JSON top-level blockingFindings and nonBlockingImprovements arrays with title, failureMode, issue, suggestion, rationale; prompt and scope filtering handle file vs requirementId cases.; R2 — Implemented approved blocking failure mode list and rejects blocking findings with any other failureMode via ImplReviewFinding constructor; prompts also list only the three modes.; R3 — Impl review prompt policy explicitly classifies regression failures, test false positives, scope creep, project-rule violations, naming/refactor/DRY/comment/docs proposals as non-blocking or out of scope, and blocking parsing rejects non-approved blocking failure modes.; R4 — Diff adds impl-review.json writing under the spec directory with version, phase, generatedAt, verdict, summary, blockingFindings, nonBlockingImprovements, and excluded missingFile/outOfScope counts.; R5 — Diff adds review.md writing via writeImplReviewArtifacts and formatImplReviewMd renders separate blocking/non-blocking sections with explicit empty-bucket messages.; R6 — Implemented verdict/routing is based on blocking findings: zero blockers yields PASS when both buckets are empty or ADVISORY when only non-blocking improvements exist, and ADVISORY is treated as passing for retry/next-step flow rather than FAIL.; R7 — Impl review artifact verdict is derived from bucket counts: FAIL for blocking findings, ADVISORY for advisory-only findings, and PASS for both buckets empty; run-review post-processing exposes that as artifacts.verdict.; R8 — Impl PASS/ADVISORY artifacts are treated as pass for retry handling and parse/run paths set next to gate-impl when verdict is not FAIL.; R9 — FAIL verdict returns next null, is not treated as impl pass for retry accounting, and post-hook leaves review pending instead of marking review done or advancing to gate-impl.; R10 — Previous review memory includes verdict, blocking/non-blocking counts, prior blocking findings, acknowledged non-blocking improvements, and explicit slice/text truncation limits.; R11 — impl review.md, implement.md, and buildImplReviewPrompt system rules all include the same three R2 failure mode labels.; R12 — Impl reviewer prompt and impl/task prompt files state non-blocking improvements are optional and require a touched file, observable issue, and replacement action naming function/branch/assertion/prompt sentence/artifact field.; R13 — Scope filtering is applied to both blockingFindings and nonBlockingImprovements, drops and counts missing-file/out-of-scope file findings, and preserves missing_acceptance_requirement blockers with valid requirementId and empty file.; R14 — Diff adds spec-local tests and shared unit tests covering JSON parsing, scope filtering, review.md rendering, impl-review.json rendering, ADVISORY retry behavior, and impl review phase transitions.; R15 — post hook branches on impl structured verdict: PASS/ADVISORY mark review done; FAIL returns without completing review, and impl output routing uses next=null so gate-impl is not promoted.; R16 — Task-scoped --task-spec review now uses the same structured impl review path, writes review.md and impl-review.json, returns PASS/ADVISORY/FAIL verdict artifacts with taskId/target, and task review prompt text was updated to the same blocking/non-blocking policy.; R17 — src/flow/prompts/task/review.md now describes the structured blockingFindings/nonBlockingImprovements contract, lists the same three blocking failure modes, makes non-blocking improvements optional, and removes the old proposals-in-review.md/NO_PROPOSALS workflow.; Spec Test Coverage — The diff adds spec-local tests under specs/265-impl-review-blocking-pass/tests/ and each new file includes a // spec: R<N> header; the structured artifact test header covers R1 through R17.;
